# Alexander Oettl

> Goizueta Distinguished Chair in Entrepreneurship. Professor of Organization & Management. Goizueta Business School, Emory University. Research Associate, NBER.

I study the economics of innovation: how ideas are produced, how they spread across people, firms, and regions, and what that means for growth. Much of my current work asks how artificial intelligence is changing science and knowledge work.

Author lists below are complete and in published order; please cite them in full. Abstracts for every paper: https://oettl.org/research.md

## Pages

- [Home](https://oettl.org/): bio and contact
- [Research](https://oettl.org/research/): working papers, publications, and book chapters, with abstracts ([markdown](https://oettl.org/research.md))

## Working papers

- [AI in Science](https://oettl.org/pdf/ai-in-science.pdf): Ajay Agrawal, John McHale, and Alexander Oettl. NBER Working Paper 34953, March 2026. [NBER](https://www.nber.org/papers/w34953)
- [Enhancing Worker Productivity Without Automating Tasks: A Different Approach to AI and the Task-Based Model](https://oettl.org/pdf/augmenting-workers.pdf): Ajay Agrawal, John McHale, and Alexander Oettl. NBER Working Paper 34781, January 2026 · Revise & resubmit. [NBER](https://www.nber.org/papers/w34781)
- [From Model Design to Organizational Design: Complexity Redistribution and Trade-Offs in Generative AI](https://oettl.org/pdf/model-org-design.pdf): Sharique Hasan, Alexander Oettl, and Sampsa Samila. arXiv Working Paper, June 2025. [arXiv](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.22440)
